description: Harvest Horizons is a team from Dar es Salaam, founded by Ayman Abdulfatah and Bhavik Boyapati. We use NASA Earth data to help farmers adapt to shifting rainfall, rising temperatures, and changing growing seasons. Our goal is to turn complex satellite data into simple, actionable guidance on when to plant, what to grow, and how to protect yields. We are building solutions that are accessible, sustainable, and designed with local farming communities in mind.
summary: Kilimo Smart is a crop-rotation decision-support tool that helps farmers plan multi-year rotations that protect soil, conserve water and build resilience. A farmer enters their field, soil, crop history and priorities. The app then shows NASA data for that location, with its source and limits, and generates three rotation plans: one for soil improvement, one for water conservation and one balanced. Each plan shows a season-by-season timeline, six transparent scores with their formulas, and a plain-language explanation of its trade-offs and uncertainties. Farmers can edit a plan, test it under hotter or drier conditions, and save or export it. It uses NASA POWER climate history and MODIS vegetation data. It is decision support only: it does not predict yield or income.
details: Kilimo Smart is an agricultural intelligence and learning platform designed to help farmers make better, more informed farming decisions using NASA Earth observation data and artificial intelligence. Through Nasa Earth Data , the platform transforms satellite observations, including vegetation health (MODIS NDVI), soil moisture (SMAP), rainfall (GPM IMERG) and land surface temperature (ECOSTRESS), into understandable insights about agricultural conditions and planting sites. Missons provides practical, locally relevant agricultural techniques covering soil health, composting, planting, irrigation, pest management and harvesting, helping farmers learn how to maintain healthier and more productive farms. At the centre of the platform is Mavuno, an AI assistant designed to help farmers understand their farm information, interpret available satellite observations and access relevant agricultural guidance through natural conversation. By combining NASA data, practical agricultural education and AI assistance in one accessible platform, Kilimo Smart aims to bridge the gap between complex Earth observation technology and everyday farming decisions, supporting more informed and climate-resilient agriculture in Tanzania and across East Africa.
